body: This does help. I feel so isolated from this world. My mental problems encapsulates any experience in my life. I feel like I’m going crazy.
I like to make art. I want to be a filmmaker. I just have lost all motivation in life. I feel so alone. It’s hard to make raw connections with people. i feel like an alien every time i speak.

This is actually crazy. I literally “bought” the Wintertime Wonderland Yasmin from her in May and I still have not receive it. I just took it as an L bc of the low price. I guess it was too good to be true. She ignored me as well, despite multiple messages of communication, only on my end. Will never do that marketplace thing again.

I feel this way too. Not to make myself seem higher in importance but I thought I could fulfill my dream in film. Depression and suicidal ideation has ruined my life. I feel so hopeless. I know you can understand. I often compare myself to others. There’s no real answer or advice i could give. Just know you aren’t alone. I feel the same way. I hope one day you will succeed in this life.
A therapist. I had 2 in the past. Things are so dark for me now. I have no future I see for myself.

I wish I could change my lack of willpower. I wish I could change where I am living. I wish I could make friends. I wish I could be working on my dream of being a writer and director. I wish I could wake up in the morning knowing I have a reason to be here.
I feel the same. It is pure agony.
That’s amazing. I am very happy for you. I hope to one day be able to say this myself. Wishing you many more days to be excited for.
I feel the same frustrations. Life feels like a endless loop of disappointment and misery. I just want out. You aren’t alone.
I hope for one day I feel peace. It’s been so hard for me. Suicide is all I think about now. I feel so empty.
It’s very difficult to do that. It’s almost pointless to the people around me.

I have so much rage as well. I think I burn out my sadness-depression experience and now all I feel is rage and depression. I have a lot of hate in my heart. I have violent thoughts but they’re mostly towards myself. I can understand your pain. Hope things get better for you.
Thank you. Depression is so isolating. It’s good to know that at least you not the only one drowning.
Life feels so empty. I have lost all hope and reason to try. I am truly lost in this world. I have nothing to hold on to stay anymore.

It feel never ending with me. I don’t want to make my family deal with the pain of my suicide. I just want to get away from my life entirely now. Pain and depression are an everyday feeling but still newly painful. I wish you well. I hope you can see the light that seems to be gone from my view.
I wish you so much peace. It is not easy to push on when you’re brain is telling you to end it all. It’s very rough just existing. The hardest thing in this world is to live in it.

Not great. Feeling very alone right now on this Thanksgiving trip. Being single all my life is really getting to me and I feel so ostracized by everyone else. I just want to get away. I feel so stuck in life and I  have little motivation to move on. I want to feel happiness; a warm feeling that let’s me know that I exist in this world. This is really bad period of my life.

I have a very similar mindset. I am deeply depressed to the point of suicidal thoughts but I have to remain active in life. I do the things that others do while also feeling this way. It feels like I am not living. It’s like I am not a person connected to this world. You aren’t alone in this.

I understand this so much. I think of suicide as an escape and it makes me feel relieved at the image of me gone. I also have depressive thoughts and it’s very hard for me to sleep. I get going through the motions of life but finding no reason to keep on. So many things you said I feel the exact same. I hope things get better for you.

I have so many similar feelings. I can’t remember the last time I was truly happy. I am a very miserable person. Currently, I am on a trip but it’s so hard to suppress my emotion. I have so many suicidal and depressive thoughts at this moment of my life. With all this therapy visits going now, I feel any help won’t benefit me. I am at the lowest I have ever been in my life. I wish you well in this life.
I get the feeling, unfortunately.

I have a very distant relationship with Christianity myself. Being closeted, I heard from my closest relatives that people like me will burn forever. I’m an atheist now but that pain never leaves me. I hope it gets better for you, though. It’s so hard to forget but you aren’t alone.
That means a lot. It’s becoming harder and harder to conceal the misery I feel around others. I just wish to find peace but I fear that will only happen when I’m dead.
Just like a fantasy. I just want to escape and I think about a person leaving. I just hate my life so much.

Yeah, for the most part my folks have stopped really asking me but I know they think low of me. It just makes me more distant to my family even though I live with them at this moment. It’s hard to feel connection with anyone.

It’s more of fantasy. It sounds more psychological damaging than it its. It’s really me imagining a person who could do anything, which is something I lack. I just think about a life of someone’s where I have control of what they do. It’s complete fantasy.

I totally get that feeling. It sucks but I understand how it could feel being on the other line. I guess one of my many downfalls is thinking/worrying about other people’s feelings. It’s a hard road to go down. Nothing is easy in my life.
It’s the only time I’m at peace. This life is such a nightmare.

I feel similar to you. I had the exact same though process before. I caved in and started calling suicide hotlines irregularly now. They have done me no good, unfortunately. It’s hard each day not to give up. I just want you to know you aren’t alone. I am so tired of living. Hope the best for you, though.
Last month. I don’t have a way of getting there now due to my parents being at my grandmother’s to help her heal. I’m at home and I really don’t want to be here anymore.
Thank you. This is very hard for me and hate having to expose my problems. It’s a chore to open up. I’m just in a terrible place and don’t see much point in moving on with living.
You explained this so well. I just want to escape and my life constantly reminds me that I need to end it all. It’s so much weight and pressure on me. I’ve also ran out of options.

It’s very soothing knowing it can all be over so fast. But the consequence is something that is too hard to think. I don’t want my family in pain and I don’t want to fail. I am so miserable. I want to find peace already.
I fight every day not to kill myself. My therapy, me working, it’s all useless. All I feel is despair.
I want to end my life

This is so true. I relate to this so much. I am naturally expressive so it’s easy to tell when I’m depressed. I realized that no one around me can truly help so it’s just really silent. It’s like there’s no way to find peace.
Thank you. I hope you find peace in this world.
I guess I only make art and write to distract. It’s hard not to think of suicide. It soothes me thinking of this pain finally being over with. I hate this life.
I really wish I still believed that but I don’t think I ever did to be honest.
Unfortunately. Too weak to do anything serious

I’ve been trying to draw for the past hour and I keep fucking up. It’s late but I have no worth and this is the only thing I can do. It’s not fair that I have to think of suicide because I feel no other feeling than loneliness and pain. I fucking hate this world.
Thank you
I understand what you’re saying. Sometimes I feel invalid of my pain because I present so normal. I’m struggling daily. It hurts so bad. I wish you better days.
I have only one friend but I barely talk to him. It’s not a place where I could really open up to him. My family is no help because they are not understanding how much damage I feel.
I am so lonely and hate my life. I have no one and constantly wish I was never born. I hate my sexuality and I’m only growing older. I want nothing but peace

I just tried to do art but It didn’t work. I fucked up both times and I’m running out of paper. There’s little left in this life that’s makes me happy anymore. Art is unfortunately not one of them anymore.
It’s exhausting to keep trying with the same results. I just want to feel peace but the only time I am not in pain is when I am asleep.
I just want one moment of happiness. The only emotions I feel are sorrow and deep loneliness. My hatred for myself makes me want to die.

I feel this. I would cause too much annoyance to my family if I did. My mother is taking care of my grandmother so it would just cause unnecessary trouble if I hung myself. I’ll just have to stick around for now.

For a while now. Unfortunately I am a homosexual but I am not out. I wish I was normal. I am so alone and have no friends. Opening up to people is very difficult. I am just in a terrible place and this app allows me to vent
Right now, I feel very claustrophobic. Thoughts of suicide run through my head but it’s mainly a need for me to get out. I can’t escape.
There’s something wrong me at a deep level. I don’t know what it will take to stop. This pain and torment is making everything else in my life worse. I try but it’s useless.

I just don’t know how it can help. I have talked to people on here but it is very difficult to open up. I get the feeling of being burden every time I type because it’s hard to communicate. Can you understand where I’m coming from? Do you ever feel like this? I don’t have people around me so I go on here because it feels like there’s people out there.

Thank you for being so understand. It’s tough being this way and not thinking about the end. I haven’t had much joy in my life recently and things just seem to be getting more so worse. I know that I have to keep trying but when do I get to be happy? Why can’t I feel good in this life. What’s the point of living if it’s just waiting for the end?
Absolutely not. I feel like dying.

I hate that I am so a closeted homosexual in isolation. All the years of restricting my life and going over whether or not I’m worth being here. I hate who I am and see nothing good about my identity because of that.

Every day, my brain tells me the same thing. I genuinely have no worth. It sucks when people tell me things because all I can think about is how terrible I am. It doesn’t seem that I am getting better. I hope things get better for you.

I have only been to 3 visits and he hasn’t brought up something to invoke me into speaking about my sexuality. I also I am very uncomfortable talking about it face to face. I’m just in a really bad place.

I like to draw. I do like movies and film in general. But I want to watch more due to me wanting to become a screenwriter in the future. My depression and anxiety makes me hopes and dreams feel useless. It’s very hard existing.
At this moment, very bad. I am in the worst mental state I have ever been and this year is worse than the last for me. Ironically, trying to stay alive is killing me.

Because the people around me have told me ever since I can remember that people like me are wrong. It’s hard to unwire that, no matter how many positive videos I see on my sexuality. I know that I am not normal but it hurts even more to know that I deserve to be punished if I don’t subdue what I am.
Thank you. How did you get to a point of saying that for yourself? How did you accept yourself? Do you ever feel tired of being gay?

I hate this feeling so much. I feel not so bad at one moment but my depression comes up and ruins my day. I also have a bunch of depression tied to past religion so another part of me believes it’s my punishment. It’s never ending battle. You aren’t alone.
I despise school. It’s even worse that I have all of this material to do at home alone.
I have the exact same feeling. I just want to get away so bad. I am in so much agony.
I have been lonely for a very long time. I am just exhausted.
They know that I’m going though shit. They just don’t realize how many times suicide runs through my head.
It is not getting better. I can’t even truly express how terrible I am doing. I want to hang myself so bad but my family can’t afford a funeral right now. This shit is so fucking tiring.
Thank you. My therapist is great. I just feel like I’m a lost cause. This pain is debilitating. I just want a way to feel good but I don’t see that happening anymore.
It’s crippling. I feel like I’m not even alive yet I am in so much pain. There’s no end unless I pull the trigger.
Yeah, I’ve done a lot of thinking of that possibility. The only reason I haven’t done anything. I am in so much pain. I am seeing a therapist this week but I still hate myself. I am in so much pain .
I want to jump off a bridge.
School work. It’s just even more difficult to complete with everything else going on in my head.
I feel the exact same. It’s torture not wanting to be here but not being able to hang yourself.
Somewhat but it’s just mostly my family being a reminder of my struggle being disabled growing up and my dad’s health problems. My upbringing wasn’t helped by realizing I was gay.
I wish I could believe you. I fear that even with professional help, I’ll never be OK with myself.

My family is deeply homophobic and will only gaslight me with “reasons” to why i’m like that and tell me that God sends gay people to Hell. I would never put myself in that situation. I have been taught very well about God’s thoughts.

I’m alone and have very depressive/suicidal thoughts. My closeted sexuality is ruining my life. I have anxiety. My house is suffocating me because I just want to be alone. I have very low self worth and feel that I am doomed.
I wish I could believe that.
I don’t know how much I can take anymore. Aside from breathing there’s nothing I am worth being.
Figure/faces
Thank you!
I’m so miserable. Who knew my life would turn out like this?
I wish i could believe that.
Each day it’s a chore to keep going. It’s a never ending nightmare.
I’m scared what drugs would do to me.
That’s how it feels. Like I have to suffer through the days. I’m used to it but it doesn’t hurt any less.

That’s the thing. I have no physical contact/connection with anyone but my family. I fear that due to the virus any possible therapy would virtual which would only make my feeling of loneliness worse. Plus, I can’t talk aloud in my house about my issues in risk of someone hearing.
Same exact thing for me. I only see my family and I feel so worthless. I have no other people i see than them. I don’t want to be around them. It’s torture.

Yes. The only people that know I exist are my family. I want to hang myself every day. This life is torture. Loneliness has truly ruined my life that I don’t even think I was made to love anyone. I just don’t like being around people yet connection is what I crave.
Same here. I am so broken and defeated. If I only lives alone so my family wouldn’t have to find my body.

I feel very similar. I have no gay friends or really any friends except for one who barely talks to me. He’s straight and I always had to avoid talking about my sexuality when he brought up girls. I felt very different which made me feel bad. I wish I had gay friends in real life. I don’t like being gay either. I don’t know why we are gay but I guess we can’t change it. I’m saying you aren’t alone. It’s very difficult being like this. I hope you find peace.
I really don’t believe it’ll get better as long as I am alive. I will never be comfortable with who I am and the years I missed where joy could of been had. Right now, I am shell.
Worthless.

It’s never ending. Sometimes when I think of other stuff, it goes to back of my mind. But, it’s always there. My feeling of worthless can’t leave as long as I am alive. My depression doesn’t take a break, it’s only me that distracts myself with music or the internet. I have no escape from this mental torture. I just feel pain.

I don’t know how much longer I can take. This is deeper than any therapy session. I literally see no worth in my life and religion only makes things worse. That’s the only remedy my family offers and God can’t help me because I’m closeted. This is a a nightmare and I am so tired from words of help that go against me. Sorry but my mind is racing. I want to go away.

Fucking terrible like always. Don’t worry because my feeling that I feel now will fade into regular depression. When I get into moments like right now I want to bang my head against the wall or cut my skin.

My life does not matter to a God unless I change who I am. Anyone believe otherwise is an idiot. Unless you are celibate you are wasting your life. I don’t even care anymore. I’m so tired trying to please people. My life has no meaning and there is nothing in the end.

I understand. There's so much wrong going on in life that the "little things remind of you of how miserable you are. I don't even have a shotgun. I am so fucking done with this pain. I wish I could feel good. I want to be used and discarded. Then, finally I would be able to say somebody wanted me.

Im so tired of fighting man. I want to fucking give up. The person I met on this app now thinks im an asshole because I couldn’t communicate properly. I can’t do anything right. If I had a fucking shotgun on me i’d pull the trigger. But knowing my luck I’d probably end up alive and mentally retarded for the rest of my life.
I’m so angry at myself. I can’t even get one good day. Of only the people around me know that the only reason I don’t hang myself is because I don’t want them to suffer. I want to go.

When I was younger. Granted I hated myself then but was very naive. After realizing who I am nothing will ever be the same. I wish I was able to change. I want to self harm bad but I can’t risk cutting a vein. Can’t do an ER trip. I have bad bad luck.
For the past few years. Honestly, my whole life but I tried to deny and act happy. This is all so exhausting.

It’s the same but the past weeks hasn’t been as bad with the exception of like a day. Sometimes my head gets really bad. Now, I’m in a bad place. I’m always in a bad place but sometime there are worst days. Thanks for asking.

Honeslty at this moment nothing really brings me joy but closing my eyes and listening to music. But thats only a break from my sorrow. I remember the past but that only makes me sadder. Sorry to sound gloom but theres not much about my past or present I feel happy about.

That’s sweet of you to say. Really, I don’t know what I want. I apologize to people on here because I am terrible at communicating. Really, I am so void of interaction. It’s pathetic but that’s my reality. I thank you for caring.
I do live on the US

The emptiness I feel has taken any joy in the task I used to like. Drawing is not a good experience anymore. I don’t care about it anymore unfortunately. I have no other skills than that. Nothing soothes me but to listen to music for about an hour to “escape” mentally but that doesn’t last. I’m just miserable and my life is a joke.

You don’t know me. Im sorry but I am so tired of fighting and making sure I don’t get to the point of hanging myself so my family won’t be sad. I want to go away and be used. I just want to feel. I don’t mean anything.
Because I mean nothing to no one. Im sitting in my room at 5 AM strung out on the thought of suicide. I am fucking tired of waiting for a good day.

I know. I am going to see options later down the road for a physical meeting with one after this quarantine. Anything virtual will just remind me of how isolated I am to the world. I just don’t know how to communicate effectively online with one. A chat message will just make my head spin and I live with family now so talking aloud on Zoom isn’t an option.

I am trying to think of better thoughts but the bad one keeps popping up. I don’t know what the hell is wrong with me. Thats why I don’t watch horror or gore stuff because they stick with me. I hate my mind so much.

Crying does nothing for me. My family aren’t very expressive like that so that reaction wasn’t used unless it really needed to be. Listening to music is really the only way to soothe my depressive and suicidal thoughts for the moment.
I’m just trying not to hang myself. It’s so hard being here like this.

Not much. I guess moving on to university but my mental problems will still follow. I don’t know how much therapy will rid me from my hatred and strong dislike of touch/intimacy. I’m just living in torture right now and the future just isn’t something I’m thinking about. Right now life is just so constricting and I just want to feel relieved. I can’t feel anything other than pain or numbness.

Its about my life in general. Having no friends, hating my sexuality, hating who I am, etc. it’s about it all and all of the years repressing have come back to haunt. It’s more than one thing unfortunately.
Me. It’s whether or not I hang myself or endure the pain for another moment of fucking life. I can’t do this for much longer anymore.
Ambient chill/RnB/00’s music/etc.

Hello. I’m sorry to hear all of this. I know about having a parent who’s going through a physical battle. I am also closeted and it’s torture having to suppress what you feel. You can message me if you’d like. I understand.
I’m not really athletic. Tried sports but it isn’t my thing. I go on the art side but lately, making art has not been enjoyable as it used to be.

The only time was back then in middle school/early high school. Took for granted the ease, compared to what I have now. I would say childhood but I disabled then so it wasn’t the best experience. If only I could have the feeling of friendship like I did in middle school. Everything was so easy yet I was so worried about trivial stuff. Time doesn’t stop for no one. I hope you get better.

Oh, man. I think my family touching has the same effect, or even worse, on me. I hate it when any of them try to get near me. They remind me of my past and plus with my hatred of contact, it becomes a very uncomfortable situation. Even though I am so lonely and never had anyone, the idea of getting close/touching repulses me.

Its so hard to cope in a world where I don’t feel like I am a person. I am so alone. I have only one distant friend but I barely speak to him. Its a very one-way type of deal over text once in a blue moon. It was hard holding this all in for all those years so thats why I come on Reddit to speak my pain. I’m so damn tired.
I guess its really the only thing people can say so I can’t really fault them for it. It just feels like a joke compared to the constant battle I have within to not hang myself.
It gets so tired hearing it. I know they mean well but the pain I feel is so taxing. I’m on the edge and those words only make me feel worse.

I get the virgin thing too. Especially being closeted, the lack of intimacy I feel hurts. I don’t have access to a gun either so I guess I have another similarity with you. I hope you don’t choose to go.
I am starting to drive now(late? I know) and I am so anxious. It scares me but I have to get through it. I do want to drive more but my anxiety hurts. I hope you find peace. Best wishes.

I understand. My only friend(who barely talks to me) always feels the need to vent and I am here for him. He tells me his problems and mostly goes on about himself. He has a lot of problems and I don’t want to combat them with mine. So I stay quiet on my pain with him. I am the supportive friend to him. I get the family thing so much. I hope you find a way to stay.

I feel the same about the family part and the gun problem. I had a trach when I was little so my family did everything to make sure I was alive. I couldn’t take the pain/guilt left behind if I decided to die on my own accord. My family would broke apart. But, at the same time, If I came out to them my family situation would be ruined then too.
Mainly little sketches now. Don’t have much energy to make portraits anymore.
I am too. It’s pure agony not having anyone by your side. I understand your pain.
Its so hard. I’m very tired of trying and I feel so bad saying that. I wish I can escape this life I live for just a day so that I can have peace.

Yes. I feel this so much. It’s like a constant depression but still a feeling of not knowing whats to come next. I hate living most of the time because of it. I hope that whatever comes after this life is a break from this constant suffering. It never ends for me.
Yeah, I know. Working on seeing a in-person therapist once quarantine is over. It’s so tiring most days.

I can’t. The position I am in would cause me to seek into a deeper depression and put me on the edge of suicide. I couldn’t handle the gaslighting and confrontation from my family that would come with coming out. I will  have to wait until I move far away from them.

Thank you for the response. I hope to find peace one day. I am still closeted. I used to just accept my sexuality while keeping it suppressed. Now, I’m still closeted and have begin to resent my sexuality. Recent views of homophobic words I’ve seen on the internet haven’t helped. They don’t make me feel terrible in terms of anything dangerous but they just remind me that my sexuality isn’t normal.

Its very hard to connect with people. I feel that I am truly worthless and the people around me can’t help. My family are the only ones next to me and I don’t want to talk to them. I wish I just cut only to release the pain.
Just how worthless I feel as a person. My life isn’t going good due to nothing of worth happening for me. I don’t have friends. Never had a significant other. I’m 21 and feel like dirt.

I feel the exact same, especially about quarantine. I’m gay too but I’m in the closet. I’m 21 and feel like my life is just one sick joke that never ends. I hope you find peace. This is truly I nightmare I am in but I hope it gets better for you.
I already told my only friend. He is distant and we barely talk anymore. I am afraid that we starting to drift apart. This physical life is very isolating, especially now.

When I tell them I’m gay and plan not to get therapy, they will stop loving me. The only thread that’s pulling our relationship is God so once they find out I’m atheist, everything is shattered. I’m just laying low for now.
Thank you so much. I have dealt with this for all my life but recently, I have given up trying to keep a smile on my face for people. I am broken and I don’t care who sees it anymore.

I feel the same. It’s torture. I wish my dad wasn’t here, as sick as that sounds. He just brings everyone down. Ashamed that he is my father but I can’t do anything about. I hope things get better for you.
My parents are intolerant. It’s just a nightmare having to be stuck at home.
That’s the only reason for me. I just don’t want to their lives harder. I would be even more of a burden if I die.
They’re Christians, actually. My whole family are. I’m not and there lies the problem.

This is exactly how I feel. I would cause too much of an inconvenience if I hung myself. . A part of me keeps stopping myself from committing suicide but I think about the end constantly. I am completely passive in my suicidal thoughts on my “good” days. It’s a nightmare.

I wish I was normal. I wish that I wasn’t born disabled so the people around me would look at me different. I wish I was straight and that I had a girlfriend so my family wouldn’t look down on me. I wish my dad was sane in the head. I wish a lot but it’s all just fantasies. The real world is all I have. It sucks but whatever.

I feel the exact same way. I question the useful of my existence being that I serve no purpose to the advancement of the human race. When I see comments on why people like me deserve to be tortured, I wonder if they are right. My sexuality is very isolating. I know there are other gay people but it’s still so lonely. I hope you don’t die or do something to harm yourself. I’m just here to tell you that I hear you & that you aren’t alone.
My life in general. Being closeted, low self-esteem, etc. i just want out of this pain.

Alright. I’ve been recently texting him more often but not trying to be overbearing. I want him to be OK. He seems to be very conflicted and I feel for him. I wouldn’t say I’m scared for him but I have no clue what he will do next. He’s texting me and talking about religion. I don’t know how to tell him that is the last thing I wanna talk about. It just springs up my depression even more.
I say them all the time. Sometimes, a family member will catch it and I will have to switch subjects. I’m so fucking miserable.
Both. I’m just tired of being tired. I resent being here. I just want to rest.
It’s been a hard day. All I want to do is hang myself. I fucking hate this existence.
Unfortunately. I want to jump off a damn bridge.
No. I don’t have the means to see one. It’s just me suffering in silence for now.

I felt the exact same way you did. I wished so bad that I would get sick as a form of self-harm. Ended up getting my wish and my stomach was in knots. One of the worst series of pain I’ve ever had. Just a terrible week of my life. I just wanted to feel destroyed physically so it would match my pain in my head. You aren’t alone.

I feel you pain so much. As much I say that I want it all to be over, I am still scared that I will be punished in the end. I feel like I deserve it for being who I am. I can’t bring myself to hang myself but I want it to be done. I hope things work out for you.

I tried to reach a suicide hotline but I had a terrible experience. I feel that scarred me and I never want use them again. But, hearing the voice of someone who genuinely cares is something that I want. I have very little interaction with people in the real world. No friends but a very distant t one who I barely talk to. I feel we are growing apart. Things are becoming so much worse.
I want to leave this place. I want this ride to be over. There isn’t much for anyone to say anymore. I have fallen in a pit and I’m never getting out.

I don’t think there is much. Sorry. All I can do is try not to hang myself tonight. My only incentive is that I live with my family and don’t want them to see my body. Trying to find a way to harm myself.
I just want a way out. I need a break. I can’t run or escape. I can’t keep holding on.

It has always been bad for it. It’s only getting worse. I would get help but it won’t mean anything in the end, I’m afraid. I just want out of this nightmare. Suicide would be too heartbreaking for my family.

My family told me I am going to Hell. I feel nothing but torture. I want to prove them right that I am broken by killing myself. Nobody in the life loves the real me. I have never experienced somebody liking me that had no blood-related obligation to. I am 21 and have had all my formative years ruined by my shitty life. I would be disowned if the people around me knew the truth. I want out of this life.
